tagline: An editorial, type-led portfolio for an essayist & reporter.
description: A read-me portfolio for a working writer: a type-only editorial masthead, selected writing as a hairline-ruled index (not cards), reading pages that give an essay room, and a plain about + contact. The words are the work — warm-paper page, serif across, one oxblood on rubrics and links. Shipped as Iris Bellamy.
